jobs.name: Brother Bracken
jobs.note: Badger monk, black/ivory face stripes, russet habit, rope belt and crooked staff. Hero: clear light face against a darker local background at 70px.
jobs.review: 150px paired identity comparison and 70px circular hero contrast check passed

jobs.name: Dame Farthing
jobs.note: Golden harvest mouse in ivory bonnet, long tail curled around tall wheat stalk, small hanging wicker coin basket and gold coin. Keep wheat and basket distinct. HERO CHIP NOTE: make the face large and upper-central inside the 70px circle; light golden mouse against a darker muted silver-blue local background, with cream key/rim. Preserve the climbing pose idea, bonnet and wheat identity.
jobs.review: 150px paired identity comparison and 70px circular hero contrast check passed

jobs.name: Dame Hoolet
jobs.note: Round tawny owl with small round spectacles, ivory collar, folded wings, head swivelled back and stern eyes. HERO CHIP CORRECTION: the previous pale background made her disappear at 70px. Put a darker desaturated blue-grey plane immediately behind the LIGHT cream face and warm tawny silhouette, with a strong dark silhouette boundary and cream upper-right rim. Keep that local dark plane quiet; lighter warmer outer/lower plane still relates to canopy. Enlarge face within central circle; preserve glasses and owl eye discs. This per-item contrast requirement takes precedence over the family mid-light guide. No individual feather marks.
jobs.review: 150px paired identity comparison and 70px circular hero contrast check passed

jobs.name: Bridge Toad
jobs.note: Brown warty TOAD in red waistcoat, half-lidded sceptical eyes, large pewter mug held left, leaning on mossy wooden bridge rail; marsh/reeds simplified. Keep mug and rail.

jobs.name: Chiffchaff
jobs.note: Small olive/cream songbird bellman, black gold-edged tricorn hat, red coat, ivory neckcloth, raised small brass handbell. Open beak, upright pose. Do not replace with generic bluebird.

jobs.name: Hedge Witch
jobs.note: Old pointed-ear woodland witch, hooked nose and wry face, purple leafy cloak/hood, red cap point, raised single pointing finger. Keep tangled branch silhouette as a few broad shapes; very few face creases.

jobs.name: Cricket Busker
jobs.note: Bright green CRICKET with long antennae and folded long legs, playing a wooden violin with bow while seated on a brown-capped mushroom with ivory stalk/gills, not a wooden stump; small upturned metal thimble before him. Keep violin, bow and thimble, not guitar.
jobs.retry_reason: First candidate replaced the mushroom seat with a wooden stump; per-item note corrected.

jobs.name: Dishwater Nell
jobs.note: Drooping grey-green ooze washing herself in an ivory oval basin, ivory neck kerchief, scrubbing brush held right and three soap bubbles. Worried face. Keep basin, brush and bubbles distinct.

jobs.name: Earwig Mother
jobs.note: Brown EARWIG mother, white bonnet, long antennae, long segmented body with rear pincers, sheltering a small group of pale eggs and young earwigs. Preserve insect anatomy and maternal protective pose; do not make ant/spider.

jobs.name: Hob-in-the-Hearth
jobs.note: Small shaggy pointed-ear brown brownie with russet hair/beard, cream sleeves and purple tunic, brushing a wooden surface beside bowl and small burning candle; stone hearth arch behind. Keep brush, bowl and candle.

jobs.name: Aunt Aspic
jobs.note: Orange fluted jelly with stern round spectacles, open scolding mouth, embedded ivory boiled egg half with yellow yolk and a green pea. Keep egg and pea visible INSIDE jelly, not external props.

jobs.name: Ballooning Spider
jobs.note: Small friendly orange-brown SPIDER with eight legs, big ivory/black eyes and two-tone rounded abdomen, dangling on a SINGLE silk thread from upper edge against quiet sky; distant low cloud/hedge. Do not add balloon prop.

jobs.name: Brother Wolf
jobs.note: Grey wolf monk with dark brown hooded robe, ivory muzzle/chest, paws drawn to chest and gentle sideways expression. Preserve long wolf muzzle, pointed ears, habit and quiet woodland story.

jobs.name: Bubble and Squeak
jobs.note: Two joined yellow ooze faces squabbling at each other, one beneath a pale green cabbage-leaf cap, with square golden butter/potato chunks embedded. Keep BOTH distinct open mouths/faces and cabbage cap; not one generic blob.

jobs.name: Cluricaun
jobs.note: Grinning pointed-ear red-nosed white-bearded little brewer in green cap and green suit, raised gold tankard, seated by barrel; few coloured bottles on back shelf. Tankard and green clothing essential, simplify bottles.

jobs.name: Dr Urchin
jobs.note: Hedgehog doctor with spiky brown silhouette, tiny spectacles, green coat, yellow necktie, backpack bearing medicine bottles and large amber bottle in hand. Keep medicine bottles and doctor expression, no fine spine rendering.

jobs.name: Gideon, Basso Profundo
jobs.note: Large brown TOAD singer, puffed ivory throat, eyes closed and open singing mouth, burgundy coat and white bow tie, one hand raised; broad marsh reeds. Preserve swollen throat and singing pose.

jobs.name: Alderman Dozey
jobs.note: Plump golden dormouse dignitary, closed sleepy eyes, ivory cravat, scarlet alderman robe with ivory trim, heavy gold chain/round medallion. ESSENTIAL: one big BROWN ACORN with dark cap sits on the table beneath his reaching left paw, beside the EMPTY IVORY DINNER PLATE. Keep both ACORN and PLATE clearly visible. Quiet oat/hedge background.
jobs.retry_reason: Missing table acorn in first candidate.

jobs.name: Beadle Warrenby
jobs.note: Stern upright RABBIT with long ears, dark gold-trimmed tricorn, navy beadle coat and ivory cravat, wooden staff left and open stop-sign palm right. Keep staff and raised palm.

jobs.name: Changeling
jobs.note: Mischievous pale pointed-ear swaddled baby with red hair tuft and old-eyed toothy grin, sitting upright in golden wooden cradle. ESSENTIAL: holds a SHORT GOLDEN SWORD diagonally across its body: rounded pommel and horizontal crossguard at lower left, long flat blade pointing upper right. Keep sword silhouette exactly as reference; NOT a spoon or spatula. Ivory swaddling has deep teal bands.
jobs.retry_reason: Sword became a spoon in first candidate.

jobs.name: Charcoal Burner
jobs.note: BADGER worker with striped face, leather cap and ivory rolled-sleeve smock, tossing one small GOLD COIN from raised black fingers into a small fire on a domed charcoal mound, grey smoke at right. Keep gold coin as a clear round disc and flame below; local warm glow only.

jobs.name: Cradle Fetch
jobs.note: Pale little black-haired pointed-ear child in dark teal gown with red collar, both hands on wooden cradle rail. Essential: LARGE DARK ADULT SHADOW with broad brimmed hat behind the child. Preserve child/shadow story, not just child alone.

jobs.name: The Cuckoo
jobs.note: Grey CUCKOO with barred ivory/grey chest, red scarf, open beak, one wing extended as a stop/gesture; small golden angular spark beside wing and small distant bird silhouette. Keep barred chest, scarf and gesture; few broad bars only.

jobs.name: Figgy Duff
jobs.note: Round burgundy fig pudding ooze with large dark fruit spots, worried open mouth and cross-eyed gaze; ivory cloth tied at top with red ribbon. ESSENTIAL: a FAINT OFFSET TWIN OUTLINE of the SAME pudding appears behind it to the RIGHT, extending from above the cloth knot down around the right side of its round body, as in image 1. This is an echo/double outline, NOT a steam curl. Preserve the main single pudding and clear second outline, no fully painted second character. Quiet seafoam planes.
jobs.retry_reason: First candidate replaced the faint full pudding echo outline with a steam curl.

jobs.name: Frumenty
jobs.note: Yellow porridge ooze in shallow ivory bowl, burgundy berries embedded in body, ivory neck kerchief, worried face and long dark burgundy spoon held upright right. Keep spoon and bowl.

jobs.name: Grey Agnes
jobs.note: Stern grey she-wolf in deep pine cloak, protecting smaller wolf below her forearm, large angular ivory/gold lightning entering upper right behind the arm. Preserve lightning and cub.

jobs.name: His Highness, Allegedly
jobs.note: Plump GREEN FROG prince with gold crown, half-lidded smug eyes and puckered red lips, purple cloak and ivory collar, seated on lily pad among broad reeds. Keep crown, lips and lily pad.

jobs.name: Lady Belladonna
jobs.note: Young pale pointed-ear fairy witch, short black hair, floppy deep-purple hat, dark purple cloak and green leaf collar, holding ONE round dark-purple berry with green star calyx in raised hand. Keep berry, not glowing orb.

jobs.name: Click Beetle
jobs.note: Long slim brown CLICK BEETLE springing vertically, a bright ivory impact/star at its body joint and TWO pale-gold outlined motion afterimages to its left, low leaves beneath. Preserve the click action and afterimages; no captions.

jobs.name: Elder Ooze
jobs.note: Round burgundy ooze with many little faces tucked within it, pale yellow drippy cap, green scarf tied at neck and large laughing upper face. Keep the smaller faces and green scarf, no extra fine texture.

jobs.name: Goodman Hayward
jobs.note: Cheerful hedgehog in broad russet field hat, ivory sleeves and moss waistcoat, carrying a big russet cloth sack spilling two big golden acorns; hedge/field background. Keep sack and acorns.

jobs.name: The Great Lump
jobs.note: Huge grey CUCKOO CHICK, much too large for its small twig nest, enormous open yellow-edged beak, smug half-lidded eyes, barred cream/grey chest, small folded wing. Preserve the reference chick silhouette, HUGE open beak and small nest. Not an adult owl; do not add owl face discs or spectacles. Few broad feather divisions.

jobs.name: Grizel
jobs.note: Lean TAWNY-OCHRE SHE-WOLF, red-brown back and notched ear, SIDE PROFILE howling upward facing right, long pointed wolf muzzle and red-brown neck hood/scarf. Essential: large pale MOON behind her head; TWO SMALL GREY PACK WOLVES below each catching a large golden wisp rising from a DARK FELLED BOAR SILHOUETTE along the lower edge. Keep both wolves, wisps and boar as broad subordinate shapes, and the main wolf dominant. Silver-blue/misted background family; do not turn her into a fox or erase the pack story.

jobs.name: Hasty Pudding
jobs.note: Heavy round brown steamed-pudding ooze with pale drippy custard cap and ivory cloth tied on top, HUGE open mouth swallowing a small struggling SOLDIER SILHOUETTE. The soldier has dark torso, pale crossed chest straps, boots/legs and reaching arm sticking out; head already inside mouth. Preserve soldier exactly, not a mouse, spoon or berry. One pudding, subordinate tiny soldier, no extra characters. Seafoam planes.

jobs.name: Cut-and-Come-Again
jobs.note: Tall joyful golden jelly ooze, red jelly centre visible at base, holding plate with a cut wedge of itself showing a red centre. Keep plate and wedge, smiling open mouth; no extra props.

jobs.name: Fairy Monarch
jobs.note: Old pointed-ear white-bearded fairy king in purple cloak and green robe, twig/antler crown, mushroom-headed staff in left hand, reclining among three large pale mushrooms. Keep twig crown, mushroom staff and mushrooms.

jobs.name: The Gabble Ratchet
jobs.note: Large dark crow/raven with grey shoulder, ivory throat blaze, angry eye and wide open orange beak, wings spread, dark woodland silhouettes. Preserve wing-spread threat silhouette and white throat, no fine feathers.

jobs.name: Granny Stir-Up
jobs.note: Round burgundy Christmas-pudding ooze with drippy ivory icing cap, holly leaves/red berries, laughing upper face and smaller faces below, golden spoon upright right. Keep holly, spoon and multiple faces.

jobs.name: Drip
jobs.note: Single teardrop-shaped RED ooze with curled pointed tip, tiny worried eyebrows/eyes and small open mouth. Preserve red, not pink/green. No props, just a ground/contact shadow and quiet seafoam planes.

jobs.name: Barn Owl
jobs.note: Cream and golden BARN OWL with heart-shaped pale face, wings spread, blue shoulder cape, perched/moving within timber barn doorway, small pale moon at right. Keep heart face, spread wings, blue cape, barn beams and moon.

jobs.name: A Leg Up
jobs.note: SPELL scene: small hedgehog below giving a golden squirrel a leg-up toward a tree branch. Squirrel reaching up, big curled tail; hedgehog bracing/lifting underneath. Preserve BOTH animals and helping gesture, tree trunk at right.

jobs.name: Acorn
jobs.note: ITEM: one single large tan acorn, plain dark brown cap and short curved stem, clear round nut silhouette. No cap crosshatching, no face, no extra nuts; clay-rose broad planes and upper-right cream glint.

jobs.name: Elderflower Cordial
jobs.note: SPELL: one large corked clear bottle of golden cordial, green elder leaves and large ivory elderflower umbels; no tiny florets. Broad clay-rose background.

jobs.name: Golden Egg
jobs.note: SPELL: one large luminous golden egg resting on simple straw nest; black bird silhouette and pale ivory outlined bird silhouette above it with a few simple sparkle stars. Preserve both bird silhouettes and egg.

jobs.name: Great Hoard
jobs.note: ITEM: open iron-bound brown wooden treasure chest overflowing with golden-brown acorns, several spilling toward foreground. Keep open lid, iron straps and acorns; no coins or gems, simple broad nut shapes.

jobs.name: Bread from the Back
jobs.note: SPELL: one BIG WHOLE ROUND GOLDEN-BROWN LOAF passed from paw to paw: upper-right BADGER paw with black fur and ivory wrist stripe, middle-right russet FOX paw holding loaf underneath, small pale receiving paw reaching up from bottom. Keep ALL THREE distinct hands and uncut round loaf with two broad pale scores. NO knife, NO cut slices, no faces/new characters. Quiet clay-rose planes.

jobs.name: Cold Frame
jobs.note: SPELL: wooden cold-frame garden box with tilted clear glass hinged lid, single large green seedling inside, SNOW bank outside and pale sky. Keep lid, wood box, seedling and snow; no invented greenhouse building.

jobs.name: Harvest Supper
jobs.note: SPELL: long table with big golden pie in foreground, bread/cups along table, several dark woodland guest silhouettes seated on both sides, overhead lantern hanging from timber barn beam, evening beyond. One focal table/pie, simplified guests. Preserve banquet story and lantern.

jobs.name: Boundary Stone
jobs.note: SPELL: single tall irregular grey standing stone with mossy green cap and large pale circular rune, surrounded by simple pale dashed ring on ground. Preserve stone, circular rune and ground ring, not lettering.

jobs.name: Hiring Fair
jobs.note: SPELL: three woodland applicants, BADGER left, long-eared RABBIT centre, SQUIRREL right, on low wooden platform holding BLANK ivory placards; small hedgehog recruiter seen from behind below holding big russet sack of acorns. Keep species, blank signs and recruitment scene. Simplify faces, no text.

jobs.name: Beltane Bonfire
jobs.note: SPELL: one big golden/cream bonfire over crossed logs, rising vertical gold coins, small pale dancing woodland animals round base, warm lavender dusk background.

jobs.name: Birds fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK ID birds is CURRENTLY a RED SQUIRREL scholar, not a bird: preserve the referenced squirrel identity exactly. Rust red squirrel with big curled tail, green embroidered-edge cape/clover brooch, open engraved slate tablet held upright, small pack. Woodland/stone clearing. Simplify tablet marks to broad decorative spirals, no letters. Use Birds warm sky-grey background.

jobs.name: Bog folk fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK: brown OTTER/long-bodied mustelid in broad straw reed hat, teal tunic with cream crossed sash, wooden walking staff, calm friendly face, broad reed marsh. Preserve otter identity, hat and staff. Warm reed/lichen background.

jobs.name: Hedgerow folk fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK: friendly golden/cream MOUSE engineer, round ears, burgundy knitted cap with red pompom, russet vest over cream sleeves, holding golden cogwheel and red-handled precision tool. Keep gear and small tool, simplify knit/no texture, quiet oat background.

jobs.name: Hunters fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK: RED SQUIRREL scholar, huge curled rust tail, green cape with clover brooch and simplified decorative edging, holding engraved grey slate tablet, small pack. Preserve squirrel not wolf; simplify tablet marks to broad spirals, no text. Silver-blue woodland planes.

jobs.name: Neutral fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK: friendly plump brown MARMOT hiker, green alpine hat with pale flower, green backpack, hiking staff and gold cowbell at neck; simplified distant mountains and wooden alpine hut. Keep marmot, hat flower, bell, pack and staff. Clay-rose family, subdued scene.

jobs.name: Oozes fallback
jobs.note: TRIBE FALLBACK: cute olive-green mottled OOZE with huge shiny dark eyes, small dark mouth, plum knitted cap and small purple heather sprig held in its hands. Keep green colour, hat, huge eyes and heather. Reduce spots to a few LARGE quiet green wash shapes, no mottled surface texture. Pearl seafoam background.
